ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central region and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across the visible ventral surface, bounded by an irregular black border; multiple thin, low-intensity vertical streaks (drips) extend approximately 15-20% into the white field from the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the visible boundary; several deep V-shaped indentations located on the distal third of the lobe, creating a 'torn' appearance relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall concave trailing edge trajectory characterized by irregular pixel offsets.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, raised-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tip of the fluke, consistent with localized surface colonization or irregular scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) extending from the serrated edge downward toward the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extremely irregular and jagged loss of tissue on the trailing edge, particularly a deep, wide indentation on the outer quadrant of the lobe suggestive of past physical trauma.
